newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore April CPI rises 1.4 percent on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore April CPI rises 1.4 percent on year.

text.p: Singapore's October consumer price index (CPI) was up 1.4 percent from a year earlier and unchanged from September, the Department of Statistics said on Sunday.
In September, the CPI rose 1.5 percent from a year ago and was unchanged over August.

Note - In October on a year-on-year basis food rose by 3.1 percent. Costs of housing and health care rose by 0.6 percent and 2.7 percent respectively. Clothing slipped 0.1 percent and transport and communication were down 0.6 percent. Education and stationery rose 2.7 percent and miscellaneous was up 1.2 percent.
